Checks run from your phone

When you check a name, the app on your phone (not our servers) requests the public profile page of that name from each listed site. We cannot see those requests or the results. Only check names that are yours or that you are thinking of using.

Monthly reminder

If you turn it on, the reminder is a notification scheduled on your phone. No server is involved, and you can turn it off in Settings.

Usage and crash data

The app sends crash reports, diagnostics and anonymous usage events to Firebase. They never contain the usernames you check. Turn this off any time with Settings > Share usage and crash data.

Ads and tracking

The free plan shows ads from Google AdMob, which may use your advertising ID. In the EU/UK and similar regions you choose first in a consent screen, and you can change it in Settings > Ads privacy options. On iPhone, the app asks permission through Apple's tracking prompt before it tracks you; if you say no, ads are not personalised. Pro removes ads.

Deleting your data

There is no account to delete. Delete one name in the app, or use Settings > Clear all my data to remove saved names, results, marks and notes. Uninstalling the app removes everything stored on your phone. Purchase records are held by Apple or Google and RevenueCat.

Age

The app is intended for adults (18 and over).

Service providers

The app uses these third-party services, which process data on our behalf under their own privacy terms:

  • Firebase Analytics (Google) — usage analytics (privacy policy)
  • Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting and diagnostics (privacy policy)
  • RevenueCat — subscription and purchase status (privacy policy)
  • Google AdMob — advertising (privacy policy)

Purchases

Subscriptions are processed by Apple or Google. We receive confirmation of your purchase status (through RevenueCat) but never your payment details.

Children

The app is not directed to children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country) and we do not knowingly collect their data.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or the CCPA) you may have the right to access, correct, delete or export your data and to object to certain processing. Contact us through the support page and we will respond within 30 days.

Security and transfers

Data is transmitted over encrypted connections. Service providers may process data in countries other than yours.

Changes

If this policy changes materially we will update the date above and, where required, tell you in the app.
